passage_flags.claim: Years of fighting put the Red Sea ports under heavy pressure, and trade and public revenues were disrupted as a result.
passage_flags.problem: booklet says only that renewed fighting disrupted local supply lines; no statement on Red Sea port pressure or on trade and public revenue disruption

passage_flags.claim: Fighting continued along the coast for several years, and civilians in the affected areas faced shortages and displacement.
passage_flags.problem: booklet gives no duration for coastal fighting; displacement is supported, shortages only implied by disrupted supply lines

fact_flags.fact: summary: In January 2026, Saudi Arabia carried out airstrikes on Mukalla Port
fact_flags.problem: booklet dates the January 2026 UAE troop pullout to after the Mukalla airstrikes; no date is given for the airstrikes themselves

fact_flags.fact: The UAE pulled troops out in January 2026 following the Mukalla airstrikes.
fact_flags.problem: booklet is internally inconsistent on location: p5 says UAE pulled troops from Saudi Arabia, p6 says UAE military elements withdraw from Yemeni territory
